title: Tanzania’s future depends on youth taking opportunities
desc: TANZANIA: TANZANIAN youth must stop watching opportunities pass by. Across the world, governments are offering scholarships and study opportunities through their embassies, creating pathways for ambitious young people to acquire knowledge, skills, professional networks and international experience. The question is no longer whether opportunities exist. The question is whether Tanzanian youth are prepared every year …
